```ts
import { createAnimationTask, addAnimationTask } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { AnimationManager } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function startHover(manager: AnimationManager, node: { position: { y: number } }): (strength: number) => void {
    const rest = node.position.y;
    let elapsed = 0;
    let strength = 1;

    const task = createAnimationTask((mgr, deltaMs) => {
        elapsed += deltaMs / 1000;
        const phase = elapsed % 1.0;
        let offset: number;
        if (phase < 0.5) {
            offset = strength * 0.5 * (phase / 0.5);
        } else {
            offset = strength * 0.5 * (1 - (phase - 0.5) / 0.5);
        }
        node.position.y = rest + offset;
    });

    addAnimationTask(manager, task);

    return (s: number) => {
        strength = s;
    };
}
```
